dedupe_keys.name: united states northeast electric distribution circuits

description: The US Northeast electric-network team publishes raw circuit layers gathered from public utility hosting-capacity maps. Harvard Dataverse lists Shapefile and GeoJSON files for Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York, Rhode Island and Vermont. The lines represent medium-voltage feeders and include utility-provided capacity and circuit attributes where available. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage supports comparison of original utility geometry before cleaning or use in distribution-network and solar-interconnection simulations; model-pypsa provides a related network-study context. A caveat is that state and utility GIS conventions differ. Map publication dates, missing circuits and field meanings require reconciliation before constructing connected networks. Hosting capacity is conditional on utility methods and does not include low-voltage secondary systems. The own repository description and file manifest were checked without opening any geospatial layer.
